title: Two registries, one active contract per license

known_project_facts.project: A municipal compliance office links active operating-license entries in one registry to current insurer contract-holder entries in a second registry.
known_project_facts.identity: The same licensed operating organization during the same reporting month, not its broker, parent, or sister subsidiary.
known_project_facts.constraints: Within each audited monthly extract each license entity occurs once, and each eligible contract-holder entity occurs once. The agreed task permits at most one link on each side. Some entities have no counterpart. The audit guarantee does not extend to historical months.
known_project_facts.current_pipeline: Independent best candidate per license; ties and contested contracts go to a queue. Scores are additive evidence, not utilities or calibrated probabilities.
known_project_facts.resources: Review capacity is 30 conflicts per month; retrieval sometimes fails on legal-name changes.

explicitly_unknown: What match-versus-unmatched loss or objective should global resolution optimize?
How trustworthy is monthly uniqueness after extract errors?
Can retrieval omit a competing valid assignment?
